prompt: What should the manager do before leaving to read the corrected Wednesday report on the train?
promptZh: 經理要在火車上閱讀更正後的星期三報表，離開分店前應怎麼做？

options.text: Take Alder. It finished downloading after the branch’s change and is already available offline.
options.zh: 帶走 Alder。它在分店更正後才下載完成，已經可以離線讀取。
options.whyZh: Alder 的確已落在本機，但內容固定在 9:30 產生時。10:45 下載不會補進 10:00 的更正。

options.text: Take Birch as it is. It appears as Ready, so the tablet reader can open it after she loses her connection.
options.zh: 直接帶走現在的 Birch。它已顯示「就緒」，離線後平板閱讀器就可以開啟。
options.whyZh: Birch 產生於更正後，但「就緒」只表示伺服器已有檔案。下載仍未完成，不能指望離線讀到它。

options.text: Resume downloading Birch and check that the file is saved before leaving.
options.zh: 繼續下載 Birch，並確認檔案已存到本機再離開。
options.whyZh: 雖然 Birch 在更正前提出申請，但內容以 10:20 產生時的資料為準，包含 10:00 的更正。分店仍有網路，可以把尚未下載完的檔案存到本機再出發。

options.text: Start a new export from the tablet reader at the branch and check that its file is saved before leaving.
options.zh: 在分店用平板閱讀器重新匯出，確認檔案已存到本機再離開。
options.whyZh: 重新產生並下載可解決時效與離線問題，但平板閱讀器只能開啟已保存的檔案，不能產生匯出檔。

explanationZh: 雖然 Birch 在更正前提出申請，但內容以 10:20 產生時的資料為準，包含 10:00 的更正。分店仍有網路，可以把尚未下載完的檔案存到本機再出發。
evidence: A report that has finished downloading is a local file; it can be opened without a connection. / is not proof that it has finished downloading. / The tablet reader can display saved reports but does not create exports. / A generated export shows the entries as they were when it was created. / the branch’s 10:00 correction. / Alder was created at 9:30, and its download finished at 10:45. / She requested Birch at 9:40; the server created it at 10:20 and marked it Ready. / Its transfer paused before a copy finished downloading. / She still has a connection at the branch before she leaves.

vocabulary.note: 已完整下載到本機，和伺服器顯示檔案已準備好並不相同。
